metadata.question: Does the water surface area of Lake Tuz in Turkey decrease in August 2016 compared to August 1988?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Lake Tuz, Turkey location: approximately 38.5°N, 33.4°E - Compare August 1988 vs August 2016 - For 1988: Use Landsat 5 (available 1984-2012) - For 2016: Use Landsat 8 (available 2013+) - Use water indices (NDWI or MNDWI) to detect water surface 2. Masking strategy: - Apply cloud masking to get clear observations - Use water index thresholds to classify water vs non-water - MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) > 0 indicates water 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Lake genuinely has less/more water area (answer A or B) - C1: No images found for one or both periods - C2: After cloud masking, no valid pixels remain - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN or invalid values - Need to check collection size, pixel counts, and final area values ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define Lake Tuz geometry (approximate center and buffer) const lakeTuz = ee.Geometry.Point([33.4, 38.5]).buffer(25000); // 25km radius // 2. Data acquisition for August 1988 (Landsat 5) let col1988 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeTuz) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(1988, 1988, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const size1988 = col1988.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1988 Images found: ${size1988}`); if (size1988 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 5 data for August 1988'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Data acquisition for August 2016 (Landsat 8) let col2016 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(lakeTuz) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(2016, 2016, 'year')) .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(8, 8, 'month')); const size2016 = col2016.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2016 Images found: ${size2016}`); if (size2016 === 0) { console.log('No Landsat 8 data for August 2016'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 4. Cloud masking function for Landsat function maskL8Clouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } function maskL5Clouds(image) { const qaMask = image.select('QA_PIXEL').bitwiseAnd(parseInt('11111', 2)).eq(0); return image.updateMask(qaMask); } // 5. Calculate MNDWI and water area for 1988 const img1988 = col1988.map(maskL5Clouds).median(); const mndwi1988 = img1988.normalizedDifference(['SR_B2', 'SR_B5']).rename('MNDWI'); const water1988 = mndwi1988.gt(0); const stats1988 = water1988.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: lakeTuz, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels1988 = stats1988.get('MNDWI_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels1988 = stats1988.get('MNDWI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`1988 - Water pixels: ${waterPixels1988}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels1988}`); if (totalPixels1988 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 1988 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 6. Calculate MNDWI and water area for 2016 const img2016 = col2016.map(maskL8Clouds).median(); const mndwi2016 = img2016.normalizedDifference(['SR_B3', 'SR_B6']).rename('MNDWI'); const water2016 = mndwi2016.gt(0); const stats2016 = water2016.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true}), geometry: lakeTuz, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const waterPixels2016 = stats2016.get('MNDWI_sum').getInfo(); const totalPixels2016 = stats2016.get('MNDWI_count').getInfo(); console.log(`2016 - Water pixels: ${waterPixels2016}, Total pixels: ${totalPixels2016}`); if (totalPixels2016 === 0) { console.log('No valid pixels for 2016 after masking'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Validation and comparison if (waterPixels1988 === null || waterPixels2016 === null || waterPixels1988 === undefined || waterPixels2016 === undefined) { console.log('Calculation failed - invalid results'); console.log('C3'); return; } const area1988 = waterPixels1988 * 9; // 3000m scale = 9 km² per pixel const area2016 = waterPixels2016 * 9; console.log(`Lake Tuz water area - 1988: ${area1988.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Lake Tuz water area - 2016: ${area2016.toFixed(2)} km²`); console.log(`Change: ${(area2016 - area1988).toFixed(2)} km²`); if (area2016 < area1988) { console.log('Water surface area DECREASED in 2016'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log('Water surface area did NOT decrease in 2016'); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
